title: docs(pm-dispatch): card threads skip SKILL.md, fact tables read by section, patrol reads GitHub by named fields
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DMeeUPU5qaHPMckpHnnrPHi)_

Fixes #32855

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:派发技能的两份参考文件改 5 行、删 2 行、增 2 行:卡线程不再读 SKILL.md;事实表按小节 grep;巡查读 GitHub 只点名字段,CI 日志落盘后 grep。
- 为什么改:会话成本 ≈ 上下文大小 × 调用次数,读进来的文件每次调用都重付一遍;这三处是卡线程与席位常驻上下文里最大的可省部分。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字,不动代码与门禁;两个文件仍在行数上限(37 / 245)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`reading-discipline.md`(新增两行与两处删减),再看 `dispatch-runbook.md` 的卡线程节两行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`,预期两行 ✓ 且 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

Three parts, each an in-place rewrite or a same-file paid addition; no re-wrap, no ceiling raise.

**Part 1 — a card thread does not read the skill** (`dispatch-runbook.md`, card-thread section)
- :130 the cost of opening a thread no longer lists re-reading the skill: it re-clones and re-reads `os-dev.md`.
- :143 rewritten: the thread reads `os-dev.md`, the dispatch order, the card and all its comments; ⛔ it does not read `SKILL.md`; a `references/` file is read when a pointer sends it there.

**Part 2 — fact tables by section** (`reading-discipline.md` :6)
- The `platform-readings.md` fact table is grepped at the moment of the operation and only the hit section is read; ⛔ never read whole.

**Part 3 — seats read GitHub by named fields** (`reading-discipline.md`, two lines added directly under the read-order line :35)
- Patrol and probe reads of GitHub name their fields (`gh api --jq`); ⛔ a whole issue/PR JSON or the full comment text is not pulled into context.
- CI logs are saved to disk and then grepped, ⛔ never tail-only; a claim and a contract review still read the whole card/PR thread; long threads are outsourced per the runbook (its existing long-thread rule).
- `board-snapshot.mjs` is untouched.

**Paying cuts (same file, `reading-discipline.md`), and where each one's content still lives**
- Deleted 「⛔ 不用共享检出的工作树核验 main,它的 HEAD 由别的 agent 摆布。」 — still carried by the line above it (verify main with `origin/main`: fetch, then `git grep … origin/main` / `git show origin/main:PATH`), by :5 (「不取本地工作树」), and by AGENTS.md Prime Directive #11 (the shared tree's HEAD is switched under you).
- Deleted 「放行认门禁 job 的结论(`completed: success`),⛔ 不认聚合读数。」 — still carried by `platform-readings.md:38` (aggregate readings are a negative screen only; clearance reads the single job by name) and by AGENTS.md multi-agent §7 (green means the gate-carrying jobs' `conclusion` is `success`).

**Line budget**: `reading-discipline.md` 37 → 37 (ceiling 37); `dispatch-runbook.md` 245 → 245 (ceiling 245). Every touched line ≤ 120 bytes.

**Maintainer's words this card carries** (Elon, project thread, 2026-11-12 UTC, verbatim): 21:46:10Z 「任务很多，评估如何节约 token」; 21:47:28Z 「把共用的部分压成一页摘要」; 21:50:27Z 「以上建议用 fable评审，然后立skills 卡优化」; 21:54:51Z 「…按照你的意见补充立卡并全部交给 skills 车道 派发。都是 p1」. The rule text itself carries no quotation: the corpus is rules-only (the id-lint header and `os-dev.md` keep quotations only where the words themselves are the operative test), and both files sit at their line ceilings; the citation lives here.

## Tests

No code changed. No test pins the rewritten or deleted lines (`git grep` over `scripts/` and `packages/` for each changed phrase: zero hits outside `.claude/skills`).

## Acceptance notes

- Deviation: the measured parenthetical on :143 (「仓 `.claude/agents` 类型未加载(实测)」) is dropped to fit the new rule into the 120-byte line; its operative half (the thread reads `os-dev.md`) stays.
- Deviation: the maintainer citation is in this body, not the skill text (reason above).

## Verification
